about.en: Wendy's bStock (WENB) is a tokenized share of The Wendy's Company issued by BTECH Holdings Ltd, a special purpose vehicle registered in the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), under Binance's bStocks brand. It is a BEP-20 token on BNB Chain at 0xded1c5fb38c262beb9cff1e1116eff3c5bf278cd, backed 1:1 by WEN shares and convertible 1:1 with the underlying equity, with stock splits and dividend adjustments processed by the issuer. bStocks are offered under an ADGM-approved prospectus and not in other jurisdictions.
